inputs.text:
# Week 1

## Push (Chest, Shoulders, Triceps)
Chest Fly / 1x6 / 20lb 0s / superset: chest / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)
Incline Bench Press / 1x6 / 95lb / warmup: none / superset: chest / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)
Lateral Raise / 1x6 / 15lb / warmup: none / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)
Reverse Fly / 1x6 / 15lb / warmup: none / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)
Skullcrusher / 1x6 / 45lb 0s / superset: triceps / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)
Triceps Dip / 1x6 / 0lb / warmup: none / superset: triceps / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)

## Pull (Back, Biceps)
Pullover / 1x6 / 25lb 0s / superset: back / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)
Lat Pulldown / 1x6 / 50lb / warmup: none / superset: back / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)
Bent Over Row / 1x6 / 95lb / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)
Shrug, Barbell / 1x6 / 135lb / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)
Deadlift / 1x6 / 135lb / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)
Bicep Curl, Barbell / 1x6 / 45lb / warmup: none / progress: dp(5lb, 6, 10)

## Legs
Leg Extension / 1x8 / 60lb 0s / superset: quads / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 15)
Leg Press / 1x8 / 180lb / warmup: none / superset: quads / progress: dp(10lb, 8, 15)
Lying Leg Curl / 1x8 / 60lb / warmup: none / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 15)
Standing Calf Raise / 1x12 / 35lb / warmup: none / progress: dp(5lb, 12, 20)
Crunch / 1x8 / 0lb / warmup: none / progress: dp(5lb, 8, 15)
